title: Returning two numbers
summary: arcadeToWheelSpeeds returns {left, right} in an array.

steps.title: One return, two values
steps.say: A method returns one thing, so to hand back a left **and** a right speed, return an array.

marks.label: make and fill in one go

steps.title: Don't clip the turn
steps.say: If a side goes past 1.0, the motor clips it, and the turn gets lost. Dividing **both** by the bigger one keeps their ratio.

board.code:
left 1.2, right 0.4   -> clipped: 1.0, 0.4   (turn changed!)
divide both by 1.2    -> 1.0, 0.333          (same shape)

steps.title: In code
steps.say: Find the bigger magnitude; if it's over 1, divide both.

steps.title: Open DriveMath.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DriveMath` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find arcadeToWheelSpeeds
steps.say: It's further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `arcadeToWheelSpeeds` and press Enter to jump to it.
